AIIMS study links air pollution to pregnant women's health; Nanded monitors for foeticide

A study from AIIMS has indicated a link between air pollution and adverse health outcomes for pregnant women. Separately, the Nanded administration is intensifying monitoring of pregnant women. This monitoring is aimed at preventing female foeticide, suggesting a focus on gender-specific prenatal care and potential illegal practices.
